changes.title: Starfield
items: A new night sky: many faint stars and a few bright ones in their own colours, the Milky Way across it, and the odd nebula
The telescope tilts up and down (▲ ▼) to look at the stars; zoom is now the mouse wheel, Z and X, or the gamepad's shoulder buttons
Tonight's find is written in the stars: look through the telescope the way it lies and you'll see its shape as a constellation; hold the view on it to see the lines
The crystal ball is clouded for now: it no longer shows the find

changes.title: Music studio
items: New: the Music Studio (music-studio.html beside the game), for designing the game's synth sounds and hearing a MIDI file from Logic played on them through the game's own engine. The game's music is unchanged.

changes.title: Telescope
items: The telescope in the crow's nest works: press E at it to look out over the whole island, turning all the way round and zooming in on the far side, while the night carries on slowly; E or Esc to stop looking
